summary: Computes the offsets of a rectangle, given as four input coordinates (a2..a5), relative to a reference point stored in `this` at offsets 0x4 (reference Y) and 0xC (reference X). Writes the four relative edge values into `this` at offsets 0x14 (left), 0x18 (top), 0x1C (right) and 0x20 (bottom), and returns the relative bottom edge. Straight-line arithmetic; no branches.

operations.description: Load reference X coordinate from this[3] (offset 0xC).
Load reference Y coordinate from this[1] (offset 0x4).
Write relative left edge into this[5] (offset 0x14) as a2 - ref_x.
Write relative top edge into this[6] (offset 0x18) as a3 - ref_y.
Write relative right edge into this[7] (offset 0x1C) as a4 - ref_x.
Write relative bottom edge into this[8] (offset 0x20) as a5 - ref_y; this value is also the return value.
Return the computed relative bottom edge.
